_default.title: Idea → Research
_default.detail: Spend 2 weeks on customer interviews before writing a line of code.

_default.title: Research → Prototype
_default.detail: Build the smallest prototype that lets a real user accomplish the core task.

_default.title: Prototype → MVP
_default.detail: Cut features until you can onboard a user in < 10 minutes without help.

_default.title: MVP → Beta
_default.detail: Recruit 10–25 design partners; offer white-glove onboarding in exchange for feedback.

_default.title: Beta → Launch
_default.detail: Pick a launch surface (Product Hunt, HN, community) and prepare assets 2 weeks ahead.

_default.title: Launch → Growth
_default.detail: Identify the one channel that produced >50% of signups and double down.

_default.title: Growth → Scale
_default.detail: Only after PMF (retention curve flattens) — hire a Head of Sales and a Head of Growth.
